answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable bond before it can earn, like a ship paying a wharf fee before docking: the bond is locked for a full epoch and slashed if the same operator is caught running duplicate identities. Reputation then accrues slowly from attested work, so a fresh identity cannot forge instant trust — it must earn it one verified task at a time, each attestation a small opal in a ledger no single actor can fake in bulk. Attackers face a real price per identity while honest agents pay nothing extra.
